mentions.name: Pho
mentions.description: A keyboard-driven terminal UI (TUI) for reviewing pull requests across multiple repositories, designed as a fast, direct replacement for GitHub's web UI for most day-to-day review workflows.
mentions.problem: The daily volume of pull requests to review keeps increasing, and the GitHub web UI is unpleasant to use.
mentions.source_excerpt: Working on Pho [1] my own TUI for pull requests across multiple repositories. It aims to be direct replacement of Github web UI for 80% of the use cases.
mentions.author: stag
